level-direct-ready-gpio24-repeat.scope_capture_limit: Automatic stop confirmed, but exported SDA/SCL record contains a subsequent 0x06 device-info exchange and no matching corrupted response body. No time-aligned failure waveform is claimed.

bsc_off_control: Service stopped, /dev/bsc-target0 absent, GPIO18/19 input. Level-only READY toggles still reproduced write EREMOTEIO. Original service restored afterwards.
controller_irq_control: GPIO22 unclaimed input with pull-up. 100 READY level cycles with no bus traffic produced no GPIO IRQ counter increments.
scope_limit: The direction test hook confirmed Stop, but bulk waveform export timed out; subsequent rearm attempt left scope Ready. Original earlier paired-failure waveforms remain preserved in fair-pqc evidence.
interpretation: The connected-disconnected-reconnected level-toggle comparison fails after 8 successful echoes, passes all 500 (1,449,901 payload bytes over 7,153 GPIO cycles), then fails after 67 successful echoes (674 GPIO cycles). The reconnected request-write failure has EREMOTEIO (121) and an 11 us lock wait. The failures track the connected READY path in this finite reproduction. Wire coupling, controller pad/input, and ground/probe effects remain unresolved; this does not qualify concurrent authenticated PQC traffic. Follow-up failures persist with C3 tip removed, READY breadboard contacts bypassed, and controller GPIO24 used instead of GPIO22. GPIO22 specifically, the C3 tip and breadboard contacts are not required for this finite reproduction. Other common electrical paths remain unresolved. A correlated hardware-single capture locates lost arbitration on request byte 2604: expected 0x9D, observed eight data bits 0x9C, then no ACK clock. The source of the unexpected low remains unresolved.

interpretation_limit: The BSC-disabled level control uses push-pull edges. It demonstrates a peripheral-independent failure in this setup, but cannot by itself prove an identical electrical mechanism to the original open-drain publication edge.

followup_controls_20261031.source_comparison: No diff in connector I2C implementation or tools/i2c-connector-stress.py versus the earlier wiring control. Other dependencies and binary may differ.
followup_controls_20261031.wiring: READY was already separately routed, through a breadboard. C3 tip disconnected, then READY breadboard contacts bypassed. Initial jumper misconnection failed the guard and ran no workload; corrected connection passed a full Pi1/Pi2 low-release mapping. Controller endpoint then moved from GPIO22/pin15 to unused GPIO24/pin18; Pi2 stays GPIO17/pin11. SDA/SCL and existing grounds retained.
